answer: Work history locks for 60 days. One upheld challenge revokes the whole history. No identity audits its own recruit. So a challenge is cheap to file and expensive to survive, and the raven filing it has to post evidence, not a whisper. A score at the zenith is worth nothing if the record behind it is revoked, which means the win goes to the account with clean 60-day history. That takes 60 days per seat. A farm of 500 seats needs 30,000 seat-days before it can even be challenged.
